title: Reverse ETL
seoDescription: Read about how DataChannel's Reverse ETL platform allows you to operationalize your analytics by syncing data from your data warehouse to business applications your teams use

blocks.title: Activate your data seamlessly
blocks.subtitle: Sync data from your data warehouse to business apps your teams rely on everyday. Manage customer segments & audiences, set up notifications directly on top of your data warehouse.

blocks.heading: Activate data and empower business teams
blocks.body: Send your data from your data warehouse to any marketing, sales, or business application of your choice.

blocks.heading: Power of the data warehouse in the hands of modern marketing teams
blocks.body: Use your data warehouse as your CDP and keep your audiences across advertising and marketing automation platforms in sync at all times

blocks.heading: Start syncing data in minutes
blocks.body: Connect your data warehouse and start syncing data to an ever growing list of supported destinations. Choose from various advertising, CRM, email marketing & messaging platforms

blocks.heading: Set up alerts & notifications directly on top of your data warehouse
blocks.body: Repeatedly checking dashboards is a thing of the past. Now get alerts in your existing messaging applications as your data updates in the data warehouse

blocks.heading: Deliver trusted data from the warehouse into all your tools
